channel.title: Chovy's Blog
channel.description: Tech, agentic coding, and whatever else I'm building. By Anthony "chovy" Ettinger.

item.title: hqterm 0.3: sessions that never drop, on every machine you own
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: hqterm 0.3: persistent, shareable terminal sessions over plain ssh that survive sleep and network changes, with Linux, macOS and Windows hosts and Tailscale built in.

item.title: OutreachGraph now finds ideas worth building and selling
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: OutreachGraph's Idea Generator reads Reddit, Ask HN and founder case studies, scores each idea on demand, proof people pay and competition, and hands the best to chovy.com to build.

item.title: Bun vs Node.js in late 2026: the benchmarks disagree, so measure your own
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Five top-ranked Bun vs Node.js articles report Bun anywhere from 4x faster to 14x slower. What each one measured, why they disagree, and how to pick.

item.title: wx93.me: a URL shortener for agents and people, launched with 9xq.me
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: wx93.me is a URL shortener built for agents as much as people. It launched today, with 9xq.me as a second short domain on the same links.

item.title: The best data enrichment platforms for 2027 and beyond
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: We ran the same 50 emails through the free tiers of ten enrichment platforms: setup friction, pricing, accuracy and the traps, from People Data Labs and Hunter to a Google search of LinkedIn.

item.title: Booking.com’s Node savings don’t carry over to Bun. Autoheal does.
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Booking.com wrote up how they cut Node.js costs by 38% with Watt. They swapped pm2's cluster module for worker threads that accept connections themselves, gave each worker its own port behind nginx,…

item.title: Your coding agents, on your phone
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: moshcode 0.112.0 puts your herd of coding agents on your phone: one-tap approvals for Claude Code and Codex, push when one blocks, and no SSH or Tailscale because the box dials out.

item.title: pwamart: an app store for web apps
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: pwamart.com is an app store for Progressive Web Apps: install on any device from web, CLI, TUI, MCP or desktop.

item.title: qc: qrypt.chat in your terminal
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: qrypt.chat's terminal client: a post-quantum chat app, a CLI and an MCP server in one command, plus our own emoji picker.

item.title: d0rz now has an API, a CLI, a terminal UI and an MCP server
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: d0rz.com, the local help marketplace, now has a public API, a CLI, a terminal UI and an MCP server: post and answer asks and offers from code or an AI agent.
